mods.name: AMOGUS
mods.description:
§4A§rnti §4M§rigrator §4O§rptions, §4G§ramma §4U§rnblock §4S§rystem
This mod shows the positions of players with migration capes by making them glow like players shot by spectral arrows but red (#bf1f00, impossible with vanilla), giving them a disadvantage at hiding. Future versions might include reach against migration cape wearers.
It will also re-enables editing the options.txt file beyond the in-game limits and changing render distance in 1.19 and increases the in-game "gamma" top limit to 5.0/500%, the top limit for speedrunning, or higher.
The top limit, Migrator glowing and current FOV are adjustable using keybinds (press to raise, shift to lower, alt to use set values).
Default keys (changeable in options›keybinds):
r - toggle Migrator glowing
g - change gamma (Brightness) multiplier
b - change FOV
u - display stats of migrators
n - show Tracers to Migrators
§e#saveminecraft

releases.notes:
AMOGUSv2.4.2 for Minecraft 1.18
- Added unicode writing support
  - Press Ctrl+Shift+U to start a character
  - Input hexadecimal code after the underlined u
  - Press any key except 0-9 and a-f to complete character
  - Currently supports codes up to U+ffff

releases.notes:
AMOGUSv2.4.0 for Minecraft 1.18

- Added support for Cloth Config
  - AMOGUS now requires Cloth Config and ModMenu
- Tracers can now change colors depending on distance
- FOV and gamma shift and min/max values can now be changed
- Glowing color can now be changed and set to not override team color

readmeSummary: To run this mod, put the .jar file in your .minecraft/mods directory and run Minecraft 1.18.x with Fabric. It is Client-side only, so you don't need to install it on any server.
